s01.translation: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

s02.translation: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

w002.function: Dative: glory to whom? The first of three datives of the Trinity.

w006.function: Dative of the 4th declension (spíritus, -us) — the -ui ending, as in “fructus → frúctui”.

w009.function: Imperfect of “sum”: continuing state in the past; the understood subject is the glory.

w010.function: Preposition with the ablative — a point in time: “in the beginning”.

w015.function: Adverb — as in the title “semper Virgo”.

w017.function: “in” with the ACCUSATIVE — extent through time: “unto the ages”. Compare “in” (w010), where the ablative marks a point in time.

w019.function: Genitive plural — a Hebrew intensifying idiom: “ages of ages”, like “Holy of Holies”; the received English says “world without end”.
